arStrings.szText: Unlocked by finding a Forgotten Altar in one of the many dungeons around Sanctuary.

Dealing damage or applying a Crowd Control effect with any of your {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Effects increases your Attack Speed by {c_random}[SF_0*100|1+%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_2}{/c} seconds, stacking once per unique {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Effect.{if:SF_9} While bonuses from all {c_number}3{/c} {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Effects are active, gain {c_number}[SF_1*100|+%|]{/c} Lucky Hit chance.{/if}

{c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Effects are {c_important}Eldritch{/c}, {c_important}Psyche{/c} and {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c}.
Gain {c_number}[SF_1*100|+%|]{/c} Lucky Hit chance while bonuses from {c_important}Eldritch{/c}, {c_important}Psyche{/c}, {c_important}Growth & Decay{/c} are active at once.
